# FairPay

## Description
FairPay is a free web application that makes splitting expenses fair and transparent. Track shared costs, settle debts, and manage group finances with friends, families, and travel groups.

## Key Features
- Split expenses with friends and groups
- Track shared costs in real-time with detailed activity feeds
- Automatic balance calculations showing who owes whom
- Settle debts with payment recording and tracking
- Manage multiple expense groups and relationships
- Multi-currency support (VND, USD, EUR, etc.)
- Receipt attachments for expense documentation
- Real-time balance notifications
- Group activity tracking and history
- Payment settlement tracking

## URL
https://long-pay.vercel.app

## Getting Started
1. Sign up for a free account
2. Create groups with friends or add individual contacts
3. Record shared expenses
4. Let FairPay calculate balances automatically
5. Settle debts easily with payment tracking

## Privacy
FairPay uses row-level security to protect your financial data. Your information is never shared with third parties. See our privacy policy at https://long-pay.vercel.app/privacy
